results.title: PySINDy — Cubic 2D ODE
results.content: The cubic two-dimensional example has dx/dt = -0.1*x^3 + 2*y^3 and dy/dt = -2*x^3 - 0.1*y^3. The displayed coefficient matrix acts on the vector [x^3, y^3].
